semantic.justification: Task140 ports actual shared SfxSetItem/SvxSetItem with independent contained base sets, original Which/copy(pool)/Clone and concrete nested Equals(true). Original SfxItemSet base copy slices derived inputs, retains same-pool parent and direct SET/INVALID/DISABLED; base-only CloneAsValue uses existing pool/state clone behavior and guards invalid derived base calls. Existing SwAttrSet native own value overload is unchanged except required TS override annotation. Native set-item classification flag is ordinary boolean state, not lifetime management. Both native initial-set overloads copy, including the rvalue overload whose initializer uses named lvalue pS; no move/reset is invented. Original presentation enum Nameless0/Complete1 is shared; SfxSetItem presentation returns false/untouched and SvxSetItem returns false/cleared via actual OUString. Unused IntlWrapper is an erased opaque argument, not a provider implementation. Source-backed MapUnit/OUString dependency edges are registered without reverse edges. Real Calc183/184 source ranges are tested directly; ItemInfoDynamic and complete DocPool/document/UI/ODS remain unported. Native refcount/cache/registration/allocator/ABI/debug machinery is not recreated; JS GC owns lifetime. Existing metadata history/classification/status and deliberate I/O/recovery differences remain without broad parity promotion. S3HW1E binds the native contained-set destructor to release actual owned entries. This supplements original value-copy/target-pool behavior; complete global instance sharing and caller destruction closure are not certified.
